description: This file defines the Memcached class within the Opencart System Library Cache namespace. It implements cache storage using Memcached, providing methods to get, set, and delete cache entries. The class manages a Memcached client instance and handles cache expiration settings.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: Class providing Memcached-based caching functionality for OpenCart, including methods to get, set, and delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached cache with an optional expiration time, creating the Memcached client and configuring the server connection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration period.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry identified by the key.
